parsed.scene_description: The image shows an empty warehouse with a forklift parked on the left side of the image. The forklift is orange in color and has a black handle. It is positioned in front of a large pile of wooden pallets. On the right side, there is a red metal shelving unit with various items on it. In the background, there are several fire extinguishers and a notice board on the wall. The floor is made of concrete and there are pipes running along the ceiling. The warehouse appears to be well-lit with natural light coming in from the windows.
